headline: "Niran Fuwattanakun" Chairs TDO, Pushing Thailand to Be ASEAN's No. 1 Digital Asset Hub
summary: Niran Fuwattanakun, CEO of Gulf Binance, has been appointed chairman of TDO. He unveiled a five-point plan aiming to make Thailand ASEAN's No. 1 digital asset hub.
why: Thailand is developing its regulated digital asset market, and industry leadership changes and policy plans shape how crypto firms operate there.
